python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0093.png')
# Floor color is around [136 172 200]
floor_color = np.array([136, 172, 200])
diff = np.linalg.norm(img[320:400, 160:300].astype(float) - floor_color.astype(float), axis=2)
# Legs are dark grey:
leg_mask = diff > 30
ys, xs = np.where(leg_mask)
print('Leg points found:', len(ys))
for u_range in [(10, 40), (45, 75), (75, 95), (100, 130)]:
    sub = [(y+320, x+160) for y, x in zip(ys, xs) if u_range[0] <= x < u_range[1]]
    if sub:
        max_y = max(p[0] for p in sub)
        mean_x = np.mean([p[1] for p in sub if p[0] == max_y])
        print(f'Stool leg: x={mean_x:.1f}, y={max_y}')
"
